Tap the device, then More… and Send a link. Paste a web page or YouTube link and tap Send link. On the computer, tap Always open on the link's banner once: links from that device then open by themselves. If nothing opens, allow pop-ups for omnibeam.site.
Type in the search box at the top of History to find a file, a device or words from a message on the tab that is open.

In History, tap Send to… on a received file to send it to another device. In Sent, Send again still works after the page reloads: files up to 50 MB a send are kept on this device for as long as Keep history says.

Tap a paired device, then More… and Add to favorites, or tap ☆ next to it in the list of paired devices. Favorites come first, stay on the screen while offline, and connect by themselves whenever OmniBeam is open on both, so files start right away. The star on the card turns green once it is connected.
